title: Morning, fog
logline: One of the month of mornings. The bay at low tide in fog, the tide line barely there, the light inside the fog. The pup a shape. The chimney across the bay a shape.

panels.composition: The mudflats at dawn in fog: no horizon, the wet mud reflecting a white sky, the tide line a soft dark thread, the pup a gray shape sitting at it, the cannery chimney across the bay a fainter gray shape. The light is inside the fog, everywhere, from nowhere. The palest page in the book.

characters.pose: a gray shape at the tide line

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, mudflats at dawn in dense fog with no horizon, wet mud reflecting a white sky, a soft dark tide line, a small dog as a gray shape sitting at it and a distant chimney as a fainter gray shape, luminous pale light with no source, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The palest page. Light from nowhere.
